name: nano-ffmpeg
description: nano-ffmpeg wraps the full power of ffmpeg in a beautiful, keyboard-driven terminal dashboard. No more googling flags. Browse your files, pick what you want to do, tweak settings with presets, and watch a live progress bar while it encodes.

issues.title: Remove redundant workflow steps and enhance file picker visibility
